thread:
rachel: Hey all, first-day onboard run failing in the step that exchanges OIDC token for short-lived creds. Error: "OIDC: token_claim 'aud' missing". Using the onboard pipeline from the docs. Any quick fix?

ci-bot: build #3 started on hosted-agent-7

tom: welcome rachel! That error usually means Buildkite's OIDC audience isn't configured in the GH App/OIDC trust. Did you follow the OIDC section in the onboarding README?

rachel: I skimmed it but didn't set up any trust myself. I thought the org GH App handled it.

claire: GH App doesn't automatically create the OIDC audience claim. For Buildkite -> GitHub OIDC we need the repo to allow Workflows OIDC or configure the app to accept the Buildkite issuer. Short path: switch the pipeline to use a machine token (GHCR_TOKEN or AWS short token) so your build can proceed, and we'll sort OIDC in infra.

rachel: Ok can someone point me to the minimal pipeline change?

tom: Add an env var step before authenticating:
```
- command: |
    echo "$GHCR_TOKEN" | docker login ghcr.io -u onboard-bot --password-stdin
  env:
    GHCR_TOKEN: "%{secure:GHCR_TOKEN}%"
```
And temporarily skip the OIDC exchange step.

rachel: Added GHCR_TOKEN via the team vault and retried - the login step passes but later step errors with "permission denied" when pushing the image: 403.

claire: That sounds like the token needs write:packages scope. For onboarding we give read-only by default. Infra can issue a short-lived onboarding write token if you request it via https://redwood.internal/access-requests. Put the ID in the build env var ONBOARD_REQ.

ci-bot: build #3 failed at step push-image with exit code 1

rachel: Filed request AR-219, added ONBOARD_REQ to the pipeline. Re-run now.

docs-bot: FYI the onboarding docs were updated with a troubleshooting snippet for OIDC vs machine token flows: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/58

tom: Great. Infra should approve the short-lived token in ~10m. Once you have it, rotate GHCR_TOKEN and mark it as temporary in the repo README. We'll follow up to make the default onboarding flow not require write tokens.

rachel: Thanks everyone, unblocked for now. Will ping if infra denies the request.
